corpus_metadata.reason: Names are present but category, category_name, toolkit and URL fields have heterogeneous partial coverage; source ID prefixes are dataset provenance, not API families.

deduplication.duplicate_policy: keep lexicographically smallest ID across candidate sources

development_status: Previously observed 300-query pilot; never reused as confirmation evidence

grouped_partition.assignment_algorithm: Anchor every component containing an observed pilot query; ascending SHA256(seed + NUL + component_id), ID tie-break; greedily admit whole components to calibration then confirmation only if source counts fit remaining fixed quotas; unused free components reserved
grouped_partition.component_formation: transitive sharing of positive gold tool IDs over full deduplicated eligible universe
grouped_partition.component_id_definition: lexicographically minimum query ID in component

label_use_scope: Positive tool IDs construct whole connected components; no retrieval outcomes or quality values used

overlap.component_definition: connected through any shared positive tool ID; entire eligible universe
